snippet.title: Shadow of Oryda – Demo Available Now on Steam | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The demo is now available – search for Shadow of Orida on Steam and add it to your wishlist!
Shadow of Orida is an atmospheric 2D metroidvania about an astronaut stranded on a mysterious and hostile planet. Explore ancient ruins, unlock new abilities, and uncover the secrets of this world as you move closer to the truth.

Features:
— Exploration of a connected world with 8 unique locations
— Ability system that unlocks new paths and hidden secrets
— атмосферic soundtrack and a dark sci-fi setting

Try the demo on Steam now.

#games #indiegame #steam #demo #gamedev
